name: Plan to Eat
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Plan to Eat, store recipes, drag them onto a calendar, and generate a shopping list. The hard boundary is browser clipping, mobile apps, sync, household sharing, and workflow polish, plus sync, integrations, and household adoption.
